Author: CJ
Name: Outer Voice
Punchline: Voiced lines for your character, and your friends', when things happen in duties.
Description:
Give your character a voice. Record lines for events like raises, deaths, Kardia swaps, wipes and clears, then share your voice pack with friends: when you're in a party together, each of you hears the other's character speak too.

Only one voice plays at a time. Everything runs on your own machine by reading what the game already shows; nothing is sent while you play. Optional: if you subscribe to a friend's Dropbox or OneDrive link, the plugin downloads their pack from that service (and nothing else).
Changelog:
- Fixed: arrival lines (Island Sanctuary, cities, homes...) could be lost right after a loading
  screen, and the plugin then treated later arrivals there as "same place" and stayed silent.
- If another line is playing when you arrive somewhere, the arrival line now waits and plays
  shortly after instead of being dropped.
- Talking to an NPC no longer counts as arriving in the zone again.
- Arrival notes now show in /xllog, including why a line didn't play.
